decisions.reason: As the flagship platform with several models that anchors the firm's strategic direction, it is a core commitment and not a speculative option, so dropping it would forfeit the base for many future solutions.

Mobile field data capture fits the established offer closely and kept its own page in both observed years, so its upkeep costs little and its value in public-sector and utility projects remains plausible enough to keep the option open.

The search extension was still being updated (version 1.6.0) and sits close to the core platform at low marginal cost, but the earlier pruning of similar small plugins shows the firm consolidates such components, which leaves a moderate risk of it being merged or dropped.
